map.name: Interactive map of Marlow
map.panTip: Drag to pan · Scroll to zoom

tool.heading: Tools
tool.selectHint: Select a district, station, line or moving train.
tool.buildHint: Build on land or click a track to insert a station.
tool.lineHint: Click the map to place stations and connect them.
tool.cannotUndo: Undo is available for edits made while the clock is paused.

menu.title: Plan a metro for Marlow
menu.intro: Connect neighborhoods across the Alder River and keep the city moving.
menu.replaceBody: Starting a new game replaces the current local save.
menu.previewNote: Explore the map to see how an operating network works.

panel.noLines: Choose Draw line and click the map to place the first station.
panel.noStations: Place stations near homes and destinations.
panel.budgetWarning: Capital spending is restricted while the budget is negative.

guide.heading: First service
guide.stationText: Click the suggested locations to connect West End homes with jobs in Central.
guide.lineText: Select existing stops or click the map to place more. Confirm the line when its geometry passes inspection.
guide.fleetTitle: Put a train on the line
guide.fleetText: Open a line and buy its first train.
guide.runText: Run the clock to see passengers walk to stations, board and arrive.

station.title: Station
station.name: Station name
station.transferNote: Enable passenger transfers between the lines serving this station.
station.removeBody: Services reconnect where possible. Trains on lines with fewer than two stops are sold.

line.title: Line
line.stopHint: Click for new stops or select existing stations on the map.
line.inserting: Select another station to insert after {{station}}.
line.headwayHint: Departure spacing at the first station. Cycle time and fleet size also affect service.
line.noTrains: Buy a train to open this line to passengers.
line.removeBody: Trains assigned to the line will be sold. Stations remain available for other services.
line.topologyNotice: Reordering stops or changing loop service restarts affected trains.

train.title: Train
train.heading: Toward {{station}}
train.sellBody: Salvage proceeds of {{cost}} go to the budget.

analysis.insufficient: Run the simulation to the next hour to collect trend data.
analysis.servedInfo: Coverage counts residents within walking reach of active rail. Trips record arrivals after the final walk.
analysis.unmetInfo: Unmet trips include unreachable destinations and journeys that were abandoned.

settings.title: Game settings
settings.noSave: No valid local save was found.
settings.saveError: Local storage is unavailable. The game is still open.
settings.resetBody: This removes the local save and clears the current network.

help.title: Planning controls
help.intro: Draw a line by clicking the map to place stops. Buy a train after construction and run the clock.
help.undo: Undo paused construction or a draft edit
help.transferInfo: Connect two lines at the same station and build an interchange to enable transfers. Track crossings do not connect lines.
help.accessibilityInfo: Use demand and accessibility to locate neighborhoods with trips beyond the reach of active rail.
help.engineeringInfo: Shift-click adds a track control point. Starting at a terminal offers an extension. Use Build station on an existing alignment to insert a stop.

error.funds: The available budget is too low.
error.notFound: That item is no longer available.
error.outOfBounds: Choose a location inside the city.
error.water: Stations must be built on land.
error.tooClose: Move farther from the nearest station.
error.needsStops: Add more stations before building this line.
error.invalidStops: Each stop must be a different existing station.
error.needsInterchange: Serve this station with two lines to build an interchange.
error.invalidHeadway: Choose a dispatch interval from the list.
error.curve: This alignment has an infeasible turn. Increase the turning space or adjust the track control points.
error.controlPoint: Place the track control point within the city limits.
error.noTrack: Choose a point on the track.
error.differentTrack: Choose lines that share this point on the alignment.

notice.enterGame: Start a game to build your own network.
notice.inserted: Station inserted on the selected tracks.

engineering.startAtStation: Click the map to place a first station or start from an existing one.
engineering.nextPoint: Click for a station · Shift-click for a track control point
engineering.finishControl: Place a station after the last control point to complete this track.
engineering.editControls: Shift-click to add a control point. Select a diamond to move or remove it.
engineering.moveControl: Click the new location for the selected control point.
engineering.smoothingUnavailable: The selected stations leave too little turning room. Adjust the route or add space between its points.
engineering.invalidRadius: The minimum is {{minimum}} m. Increase the turning space or move a control point.
engineering.chooseTracks: Choose which lines will stop at this platform.
engineering.legacyWarning: This legacy alignment may continue running. Rebuilt track must meet the {{minimum}} m rule.
